summary: F1-F4 are fixed. The targeted tests, doctor, formatter, generated facts, and committed audio checks pass. T5 retains a nonblocking marker compatibility issue.
nonblocking_findings: F5 [Nit] review-a: plan.md:165 uses legacy [ ] and an embedded deferred owner for T5. Measure specifies [b] and a trailing deferred:<owner> field. The project parser at measure/tools/common.mjs:113 does not count [b] tasks, so a marker-only change would break the doctor again. Resolve this compatibility issue during planned closeout or separate tooling work. The current doctor passes, and T5 identifies its owner and remaining work.
evidence: git rev-parse HEAD returned 7fbf58b7f7d78aee01c70fd4ad437a93b8038f98 at audit start and after verification. The supplied role_base_sha remains c86ccebe6ba5a72b388ca3118f5159875675597e.
The audit reviewed both c86ccebe6ba5a72b388ca3118f5159875675597e..7fbf58b7f7d78aee01c70fd4ad437a93b8038f98 and the complete phase diff from a9aec40d5cf899815852bbbd53b768285b98915b.

F1 withdrawn: scripts/sound-set.mjs:71 removes the previous target before spawning. tests/sound-set.test.ts:273-285 constructs a stale file and a no-write child. The passing regression requires exit 1 and the exact no-file line.

F2 withdrawn: tests/sound-set.test.ts:66 logs every invocation before the failure check. Lines 236-255 require alpha and beta calls, exclude gamma, and assert successful-output forwarding and failed-output suppression. The plan and strategy now describe the same contract.
F3 withdrawn: plan.md:3-5 records the current status. Lines 124-129 correct the false historical doctor claim. T5 records remaining closeout work. The requested heavy-run doctor command now exits 0.

F4 withdrawn: scripts/sound-set.mjs:79-80 forwards both successful child streams to wrapper stdout. tests/sound-set.test.ts:95-118 asserts the complete ordered output and empty stderr. The failed-render test excludes both failed-child streams.
The targeted heavy-run vitest command exited 0: one file passed and 17 tests passed.
The heavy-run doctor command exited 0 and printed Measure doctor found no structural errors. Its boundary test also passed.
The planned prettier command passed. An additional prettier check covered the changed test-strategy.md. node measure/tools/generate.mjs --check reported four current files.
The committed red-r2.log records three expected failures before the wrapper fix. Its raw output identifies lost successful stderr and acceptance of stale output.
A4 verification used the actual fresh-missing-output and stale-output fixtures in the targeted suite. Both require failure when the child writes no deliverable.
A3 is absent: tests/sound-set.test.ts:110 parses /(\d+) sounds ->/ and compares the labeled integer with 2. The test also compares the complete success output.

The header test compares the full AC1 mapping before reading every file. Lines 298-313 implement the specified AC3 offsets, including the segment count, packet start, stereo channels, 48000 Hz rate, and framing flag.
A read-only Python loop compared all seven working Ogg files with git show HEAD:path. Every byte matched. ffprobe confirmed stereo Vorbis at 48000 Hz for every file.

git diff --exit-code c86ccebe..7fbf58b7 over sounds, scripts/sound-setup.sh, and .gitignore returned no differences. The earlier pin, venv reuse, README content, sizes, and durations remain unchanged.
scripts/sound-setup.sh pins exactly 7a7f7c5c70d4a763a1eca4b3666af7c77e313f97. Its documented Python fallback remains within D3 and changes neither the pin nor the venv path.
git check-ignore confirms .venv-earshot/bin/python remains ignored.
The audit reread the spec, current plan, strategy, wrapper, and tests. The earlier routing review remains applicable; the phase changes no runtime route or exported production TypeScript symbol.
The earlier build-graph scan remains applicable to production callers. This remediation changes a standalone .mjs CLI, tests, and records. build-graph supports TypeScript, not this CLI.
The registry changed within the full phase, so applicable anti-pattern checks remain in scope. A5's false doctor claim is corrected. A6 and A10 show no additional defect.
F5 compatibility proof: countPlanTasks reports five tasks with four completed for the current plan. An in-memory T5-only replacement with [b] reports four tasks, all completed.
The project parser therefore cannot support the standardized T5 marker through a plan-only edit. F5 does not block the requested sound behavior or the current project gates.
A1, A2, and A9 have no changed implementation surface. A8's marker compatibility issue is recorded as F5 rather than omitted.
The audit did not reinstall or rerender. Those commands would modify implementation outputs. No audio byte changed during this remediation.
git diff --exit-code HEAD over the audited implementation, track, registry, and generated paths returned no working-tree changes.
The release worktree remains detached at e01ac17b. The shelf-sync worktree and branch remain at 623e7b5d. Their owning sessions retain cleanup responsibility.
